encoding.preamble_policy: Preserve all stored labels; no additional long carrier preamble.

acquisition_primer.purpose: Explicit sign-run acquisition; not captured protocol data

encoding.final_cycle_policy: Synthesize final full cycle; hold final phase for half-cycle guard
encoding.transition_policy: I updates at 0.375 to next high coordinate; Q at 0.125 to current low coordinate
encoding.model_evidence: Captured quarter midpoints and waveform correlation; not hardware acceptance
warnings: Experimental reconstruction; device acceptance is not established.
Source pre-acquisition waveform and noise are not reconstructed.
Primer and final hold guard are explicit synthesis conventions.

strict_phase_roundtrip.evidence: Exact complete phase labels and counts; not verified protocol/state data

limits: Each operation retains its existing calibration and context guards; no arbitrary packet or JSON-view edits are imported
Unknown packets are preserved through verified packet rebuilding; new combinations need appropriate hardware evidence
